User Request: What dashboards are already available

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend
Title: Top Customers by Region
Type: table
Description: Highest spending customers aggregated by region
Title: Total Revenue
Type: kpi
Description: Overall revenue
Title: Sales by Product Category
Type: chart
Description: Revenue breakdown by product category
Title: Order Fulfillment Status
Type: chart
Description: Status of orders (shipped, pending, etc.)
Title: Employee Performance
Type: table
Description: Sales performance metrics for employees
Title: Inventory Levels
Type: chart
Description: Current inventory levels by product
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: chart
Description: Overview of customer demographics

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Top Customers by Region
sql_queries.description: Highest spending customers aggregated by region
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.Region, c.CompanyName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSpending FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.Region, c.CompanyName ORDER BY c.Region, TotalSpending DESC

sql_queries.title: Total Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM "Order Details" od

sql_queries.title: Sales by Product Category
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cat.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories cat ON p.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID GROUP BY cat.CategoryName ORDER BY Revenue DESC

sql_queries.title: Order Fulfillment Status
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shipped' ELSE 'Pending' END AS Status, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Orders o GROUP BY Status

sql_queries.title: Employee Performance
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

sql_queries.title: Inventory Levels
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, p.UnitsInStock FROM Products p ORDER BY p.UnitsInStock DESC

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(ccd.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomerDemographics cd JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ccd ON cd.CustomerTypeID = ccd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY cd.CustomerDesc
